profile.headline: Software Engineer at Noteefy 🔔
profile.summary:
I am a results-driven, hard worker who enjoys connecting with people in any way I can. I love solving problems and working with others to produce high quality results in whatever project I am pursuing. Learning new things and growing in all facets of my life are two of my main motivators, and I always am looking to put myself in new or uncomfortable situations to accomplish this.

I am originally born and raised in Hudsonville, Michigan, but moved to Phoenix, Arizona to further my education at Grand Canyon University studying software development with a minor in sports and entertainment marketing, where I will continue to build a life and career. I love the opportunities in the valley, not just from a career perspective, but the diverse people, food, and culture surrounding various areas which have allowed me to experience many new things that I would've otherwise missed.

I have held a variety of jobs, from food service, to landscaping, to factory jobs, to my current position and career as a software engineer. My many job experiences have taught me to work hard, take nothing for granted, and always be willing to do the dirty work. They have shaped me into who I am today, and I will continue to learn and grow both professionally and personally.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Develop internal web tools used by every part of the business to increase efficiency, performance, and accuracy
- Ingest data from third party platforms through third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal processes to automate
workflows for the business, cutting manual data entry in half
- Implement integrations between systems and customer platforms to support customer-specific business needs
- Maintain ongoing onboarding and maintenance of new and existing customers to EDI processes and internal
applications, saving 5+ hours per week per customer on average
- Collaborate with executives and other stakeholders to gather requirements, define solutions, present project
updates, and receive feedback or changes in priority
- Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) from design to deployment

positions.title: Assistant Director
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Supervised print and social media marketing projects and design initiatives for promotional items
Oversees 5 team members and assists a Director, meeting monthly and weekly respectively. 
Works closely with GCU Student Engagement professional staff and GCU Student Marketing team
Coordinated team building activities twice a semester

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Planning, organizing, and executing campus events with an average attendance of 200-800 students 
Leading the GCU student body through excellence, Christ-centered leadership, and community building
Monthly meetings with team assistant director, director, and professional staff member to receive and provide performance related feedback
Worked with team and staff to provide event feedback and actionable changes for future events

positions.title: Discover Lead
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Developed and led training sessions for front desk staff, ensuring team members were well-prepared to provide
excellent customer service.
- Fostered a welcoming and professional environment for over 250 student workers by providing mentorship and
performance evaluations to align with company values.
- Delivered ongoing coaching and feedback to a team of 20 to enhance efficiency and maintain service standards.
- Collaborated with colleagues to manage high-volume guest interactions, coordinating events for 13,000
prospective students annually while ensuring seamless operations.
- Handled emergency situations, including medical incidents, security concerns, and guest issues, prioritizing safety
and upholding organizational integrity.

positions.title: Promo Host
positions.description: Skills: Problem Solving · Critical Thinking · Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a geofencing proof of concept to track and monitor company assets in real time
- Built a new OEM management web platform, streamlining internal workflows for asset creation and approval
- Developed a script to dynamically name web elements for automated testing
- Developed an internal URL shortener service to manage and simplify access to frequently used internal links
positions.insights: Skills: Database Design · C# · Jira · ASP.NET MVC · REST APIs · API Development · Agile Project Management · Front-End Development · Application Development · HTML5 · Angular · Software Development · Full-Stack Development · TypeScript · Blazor · Databases · Programming · Microsoft SQL Server · Database Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Back-End Web Development · MySQL · .NET Core

positions.title: Dynamics Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Automated processes to locate lost or stolen student devices, reducing time from four hours to one per device
- Redesigned the legal contracts request portal, improving user experience and request tracking efficiency
- Conducted data cleaning, validation, and optimization across large CRM datasets to improve reporting accuracy
- Gained experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CRM), Power Automate, and SQL for backend development
and data integration, in addition to C# and Angular.js for web development
positions.insights: Skills: Database Design · Microsoft Dynamics CRM · REST APIs · API Development · Agile Project Management · Front-End Development · Application Development · HTML5 · Angular · Software Development · Full-Stack Development · TypeScript · Databases · Programming · Microsoft SQL Server · Database Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Back-End Web Development · .NET Core
